class.name: Axis
class.brief_description: A 3D axis defined by an origin point and a direction vector.
class.description: Axis represents a 3D axis in space, defined by an origin point (position) and a direction vector. It is commonly used to define rotation axes, symmetry axes, and for geometric computations. The underlying OpenCASCADE type is gp_Ax1.

method.name: create_from_origin_dir
method.argument: The origin point of the axis.
The direction vector of the axis (will be normalized).
method.description: Creates a new Axis from an origin point and direction vector.

method.name: create_from_gp_ax1
method.argument: Raw byte array containing gp_Ax1 data.
method.description: Creates a new Axis from raw gp_Ax1 data.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the origin point of the axis.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the origin point of the axis.

method.name: get_direction
method.description: Returns the direction vector of the axis (normalized).

method.name: set_direction
method.argument: The new direction vector (will be normalized).
method.description: Sets the direction vector of the axis.

method.name: get_location
method.description: Returns a Location object representing this axis. Note: Full implementation depends on Location class.

method.name: angle_between
method.argument: The other axis to measure angle against.
method.description: Returns the angle in degrees between this axis and another axis. The angle is in the range [0, 180].

method.name: is_coaxial
method.description: Returns true if this axis and another are coaxial (parallel and sharing same line).

method.name: is_normal
method.description: Returns true if this axis and another are normal (90 degrees apart).

method.name: is_opposite
method.description: Returns true if this axis and another are opposite (180 degrees apart).

method.name: is_parallel
method.description: Returns true if this axis and another are parallel (0 or 180 degrees apart).

method.name: is_skew
method.description: Returns true if this axis and another are skew (not parallel and not intersecting).

method.name: reverse
method.description: Returns a new axis with the same position but reversed direction.

method.name: neg
method.description: Returns a new axis with the same position but reversed direction (same as reverse).

method.name: copy
method.description: Returns a shallow copy of this axis.

method.name: located
method.argument: A Location object to transform by.
method.description: Returns a new axis transformed by the given Location. Note: Full implementation depends on Location class.

method.name: to_plane
method.description: Converts this axis to a Plane. Note: Full implementation depends on Plane class.

method.name: intersect
method.argument: Another object to intersect with (Axis, Plane, Vector, etc.).
method.description: Returns the intersection with another object. Note: Full implementation depends on other geometry classes.

members.member: The origin point of the axis.
The direction vector of the axis (normalized).
A Location object representing this axis. Read-only.
